summary: docsic 0.4.0: a note sweep gives every open note one outcome (absorb, covered, renew, retire), archives instead of deleting, and lands absorbed content as one docs-only PR per project, started at session end. The first throu sweep took it from 137 open notes to 55.
why: Open notes piled up faster than anyone triaged them, so the injected memory grew stale and crowded out what mattered.
